name: Honey Grab
detailed_description:
Honey Grab is a chaotic online multiplayer game where you and your friends become bears trying to steal honey or bees trying to protect it! Team up or go head to head in this wacky battle for sweet, sticky glory. Choose your side: will you play as a mischievous bear or a vigilant bee?

Set in a vibrant, oversized hive bursting with honey and surrounded by an idyllic natural landscape, the giant bees were not expecting any visitors... let alone a full-blown bear invasion. Now, they’ve got more than they bargained for as the hive becomes the chaotic battleground for honey-hungry bears and fiercely protective bees.

As a bear (first-person view), you’ll have access to a variety of items to help you on your honey-stealing mission. These tools can be crafted using honey in the Honeymobile, your very own mobile base that you can drive around the hive. After successfully snagging some honey and returning it to the Honeymobile, you’ll need to decide: spend the honey to create helpful items, or save it to work toward the ultimate goal of hitting the honey limit and claiming victory.

Some of the items available to bears include:

  • Honey Shooter – Slow down bees by launching sticky blasts of honey

  • Megaphone – Make your voice heard by everyone on the map, no matter where they are

  • Boxing Glove – Smash through combs much faster

  • Speed Band – Boost your speed and jumping ability

  • And more…

As a bee (third-person view), you’ll be equipped with unique abilities to defend the hive and stop the bears in their tracks! Your powers are essential to keeping your honey safe and your hive intact. Your goal is to stop the bears from reaching their objective(a specific amount of honey stolen)

Some of the abilities available to bees include:

  • Rebuilding combs that have been broken by the bears

  • Stinging bears to slow and disorient them

  • Honey Rope – Latch onto bears and drag them away from objectives

  • And more…

You can choose the structure of your game at the start: play a single, standalone round for a quick session, or go for a multi-round match where players slowly amass honey over time, unlocking even more powerful items and upgrades as the chaos escalates.

The gameplay is all about goofy, silly fun that’s perfect for playing with friends. Featuring proximity chat, you’ll be able to shout, scheme, and scream as you dive into the hilarious chaos of raiding or defending the hive!

short_description: Honey Grab is an online coop multiplayer game about bears stealing honey from bees. In the game you will either choose to be a bear or bee. The bees will have abilities that they can use to slow down the player and the bears will be able to purchase items to make them more efficient.
